name: DCA out — ask side
description: Single-sided base token above the active bin. Manual only.
placeholderNote: Placeholder and manual-only. The bot cannot know that you want to exit a token. Pass --strategy dca-out-bidask when you do.
notes: Docs: to DCA out, deposit the base token single-sided and place liquidity above the current price. As price moves up, base converts into quote. The SDK's single-sided X path deposits token X from the active bin upward and sets singleSidedX. Auto mode skips this file because manualOnly is true.
